summary: Kevin states that he is not being alarmist when he calls this the end of American sovereignty. He argues it is exactly what the founding fathers sought to protect the country from, though they never anticipated the real enemy of today, which he calls America's greatest ally. Kevin says this ally did not exist then and now holds an absolute stranglehold on the United States.
